population: repeated DEV319 / 13 sessions; no independent confirmation

contract.human_grades: existing user-entered clean/moderate/severe; criterion NOT_CONFIRMED; not measured physical occlusion severity
contract.corner_states: reuse existing explicit human reference-corner visibility; no new labels; model-prediction exposure NOT_CONFIRMED; no independent physical occlusion intervention
contract.distance: reuse existing categorical near/mid/far/unknown workspace tags; no new metre thresholds; not independent range metrology
contract.frame_visibility_groups: any reference corner in category; groups overlap; never sum their frame counts into independent samples
contract.pose: all selected-instance actual F(q) outputs; failures retained; full frame denominator and paired common-success quadrants
contract.point_errors: same approved whole-object 2D branch; canonical GT identity from saved rows; full unmatched penalty plus conditional observed error
contract.seed_aggregation: per-seed rows and arithmetic mean of seed statistics; no point/prediction averaging
contract.inference: no GT/visibility/distance label supplied to scorer; label use is post-hoc descriptive aggregation only
contract.uncertainty: no new CI/significance/selection/verdict from subgroups; overlapping corners are not independent samples
contract.source_coordinate_unknown: unknown annotation coordinate provenance is retained, not promoted by the human visibility label

timing_scope: main aggregation body; excludes Python import/startup and final output serialization
